messages:
maria: FYI — scheduling a catalog enable for neptune-13b-v2 during the 03:00 PDT change window tomorrow. Need fallback ordering, thresholds for rollback, and a short ops QA. Can we confirm?

deploy-bot: Change scheduled: neptune-13b-v2 enable. Window: 2026-03-22 03:00 PDT. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% over 30m by default. Change ID: ch_2812345678. Preflight checks queued.

ethan: Suggest initial fallback order: [neptune-13b-v2, orion-13b-quant, orion-13b, sentinel-13b]. Put the quantized orion before standard to reduce p95. Also recommend reserving a pinned capacity for sentinel previous version at 100% reserve for fast cutback.

sara: Can we soften the canary? Start at 2% for 10m, then 10% for 20m, then 25% if stable. Less noisy for user-facing traffic.

kevin: Proposed rollback triggers (auto): p95 latency increase > 30ms absolute OR error rate +1.0% absolute OR tokens-per-request cost > 2x baseline for 10m. If triggered, auto-rollback to previous active model and page SRE. We should also have a manual rollback path.

ops-ashley: @maria I'll be oncall during the window. Please attach runbook and add me to the change. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/catalog-enable (ops runbook).

maria: Runbook linked and oncall assigned. Adding a temporary feature-flag gate `neptune.enable`. Enable command for ops: `catalogctl enable --model=neptune-13b-v2 --canary 2 --step 10m --flag neptune.enable`

jon: Fallback config (quick):
```
fallback_order:
  - neptune-13b-v2
  - orion-13b-quant
  - orion-13b
  - sentinel-13b
fallback_ttl_seconds: 20
priority_policy: latency_then_cost
```

maria: Also: caching TTL = 120s for prefixes, KV prewarm for top-100 prefixes, and a short warmup traffic burst at canary start (100rps for 2m) to prime kernels. We'll track cost delta separately.

ethan: I'll run a quick perf eval against the standard prompt set and post latency/quality deltas before the window. Expect numbers in the thread within 6h.

deploy-bot: Preflight status: models compiled, kernels selected, compatibility checks pass. Link: https://deploys.redwood/ch_2812345678/preflight

sara: One more ask — can we add a 1-line expected quality summary vs orion (e.g., fewer hallucination cases on summary prompts, minor drop on codegen short snippets)? That helps support/customer facing notes.

maria: Yep — I'll post a short release-note blurb and a 2-bullet eval summary. :thumbsup:

jon: SGTM. If no objections, I'll start the enable at window start and follow canary steps. Everyone OK?

kevin: OK from SRE side.

ops-ashley: Oncall ACK.

ethan: ACK.

sara: :raised_hands:

maria: Locking plan. ch_2812345678 scheduled with the changes above. If any alerts or anomalies pop, ping @ops-ashley and @kevin immediately. Closing this thread for now — will reopen with post-cut telemetry and any rollbacks.
